# **PART 1 - Required Packages**

First, check the Seurat version to ensure that you begin the analysis using a version < 5.0, as this is a requirement 
of one of the steps. Please consult the README.txt file for more details.

## Setup


# **PART 2 - Loading Metadata**

Only proceed with cells that passed Quaity Control (QC): provided by the authors.

```{r metadata, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Metadata
Metadata_Seq5=read.csv(paste0('paper_info/PickedCells_Sequenced_Seq5.csv'),
                       header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
Metadata_Seq5$cDNAID=paste0('Seq5_',Metadata_Seq5$cDNAID)
Metadata_Seq5=Metadata_Seq5[!is.na(Metadata_Seq5$TrackNumber),]
Metadata_Seq4=read.csv(paste0('paper_info/PickedCells_Sequenced_Seq4.csv'),
                       header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
Metadata_Seq4$cDNAID=paste0('Seq4_',Metadata_Seq4$cDNAID)

Metadata_Seq5$SeqRun='Seq5'
Metadata_Seq4$SeqRun='Seq4'

Metadata=rbind(Metadata_Seq4,Metadata_Seq5)

Seq5=read.csv(paste0('paper_info/CellNames_SistersPicked_TheFilter_Seq5.csv'),
              header = F, stringsAsFactors = F)$V2
Seq4=read.csv(paste0('paper_info/CellNames_SistersPicked_TheFilter_Seq4.csv'),
              header = F, stringsAsFactors = F)$V2

Metadata = Metadata[Metadata$cDNAID%in%c(Seq5,Seq4),]

# Log All Counts
log_AllCounts <- read.csv(paste0('paper_info/LogAllCounts.csv'),header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
rownames(log_AllCounts) <- log_AllCounts$X
log_AllCounts$X <- NULL
log_AllCounts <- t(log_AllCounts)
log_AllCounts = log_AllCounts[,Metadata$cDNAID]

rownames(Metadata) <- Metadata$cDNAID
```

# **PART 3 - Adding Important Information**

```{r add-info, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Seurat Cell Cycle Phases
load(file = paste0('paper_info/OutputCellCycle_Seurat.RData'))
CCPhases=marrow$Phase
Metadata$CCPhase=CCPhases[Metadata$cDNAID]
Metadata$G2Mscore=marrow$G2M.Score[Metadata$cDNAID]
Metadata$Sscore=marrow$S.Score[Metadata$cDNAID]
Metadata$TimesinceDiv_inhours=(Metadata$TimeofPicking-Metadata$TimeofMotherDivision)/2

PseudoTime = read.csv(paste0('paper_info/PseudoTime.csv'), stringsAsFactors = F, 
                      header = T)
rownames(PseudoTime) = PseudoTime$cDNAID
Metadata$PseudoTime = PseudoTime[Metadata$cDNAID,'PseudoTime']

# Account for Time Passed During Picking
Experiments = c('Exp60','Exp68','Exp69','Exp72','Exp73','Exp74','Exp75','Exp76','Exp77')

Pickings=list()

for(experiment in Experiments){
  df              = read.csv(paste0('paper_info/Pickingdata/',experiment,'.csv'),
                             header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = ';')
  df$Experiment   = experiment
  df$PickTimeDiff_inh = NA
  for(i in 1:dim(df)[1]){
    
    #For Exp75, the first two entries are '' because picking failed
    if(experiment == 'Exp75'){
      df$PickTimeDiff_inh[i] = difftime(time1 = strptime(df$PickDate[i],"%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S"),time2 = strptime(df$PickDate[3],"%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S"),units = 'h')
    }
    else{
      df$PickTimeDiff_inh[i] = difftime(time1 = strptime(df$PickDate[i],"%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S"),time2 = strptime(df$PickDate[1],"%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S"),units = 'h')
    }
  }
  Pickings[[experiment]] = df
}

Pickings = do.call(rbind,Pickings)
Pickings = Pickings[,c('Experiment','DestinationWell','PickTimeDiff_inh')]

WellID          = Pickings$DestinationWell
WellID_Letters  = unlist(lapply(WellID,function(x) unlist(strsplit(x, split = '-'))[1]))
WellID_Idx      = unlist(lapply(WellID,function(x) as.integer(unlist(strsplit(x, split = '-'))[2])))
WellID          = paste0(WellID_Letters,WellID_Idx)
Pickings$CellID = paste0(Pickings$Experiment,'_',WellID)

Metadata$TimesinceDiv_inhours_PlusPickingTime = NA
rownames(Metadata)= Metadata$CellID

for(cellID in Metadata$CellID){
  PickingEntry=Pickings[Pickings$CellID==cellID, 'PickTimeDiff_inh']  
  Metadata[cellID,'TimesinceDiv_inhours_PlusPickingTime'] = Metadata[cellID,'TimesinceDiv_inhours']+
    max(PickingEntry) + 1
}

Metadata$TimesinceDiv_inhours = Metadata$TimesinceDiv_inhours_PlusPickingTime
Metadata=Metadata[,-grep(x = colnames(Metadata),pattern = 'TimesinceDiv_inhours_PlusPickingTime')]

Metadata=Metadata[!is.na(Metadata$TreeID),]

# Match Sisters 
PairedMetadata_LysoBrite_norm_Mean=NA
PairedMetadata_LysoBrite_norm_Mother=NA
PairedMetadata_LysoBrite_Diff_norm=NA

Metadata$BothDaughtersSequenced=F
TreesWithBothDaughtersSequenced=c()
for(tree in unique(Metadata$TreeID)){
  if(sum(Metadata$TreeID==tree)==2){
    if(sum(Metadata$cDNAID[Metadata$TreeID==tree]%in%c(Seq5,Seq4))==2){
      TreesWithBothDaughtersSequenced=c(TreesWithBothDaughtersSequenced,tree)
      Metadata$BothDaughtersSequenced[Metadata$TreeID==tree]=T
    }
  }
}

Metadata_filtered <- Metadata[Metadata$BothDaughtersSequenced == TRUE, ]
```

# **PART 4 - Loading Matrix and Metadata Individually**

```{r matrix, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
matrix4 <- read.csv(paste0("paper_info/matrix_seq4.csv"),header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
rownames(matrix4) <- matrix4$Geneid
matrix4$X <- NULL
matrix4$Geneid <- NULL
meta4 <- read.csv(paste0("paper_info/metadata_seq4.csv"),header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
meta4 <- meta4[, c(2:7)]
meta4$ShortID <- str_extract(
  meta4$FastQNames,
  "[A-H][0-9]+_Plate[0-9]+_Seq[0-9]+"
)

meta4$ID <- str_replace(
  meta4$ShortID,
  "([A-H][0-9]+)_Plate([0-9]+)_Seq([0-9]+)",
  "Seq\\3_\\1_PLATE\\2"
)

matrix5 <- read.csv(paste0("paper_info/matrix_seq5.csv"),header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
rownames(matrix5) <- matrix5$X
matrix5$X <- NULL
meta5 <- read.csv(paste0("paper_info/metadata_seq5.csv"),header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
meta5 <- meta5[, c(2:7)]
meta5$ShortID <- str_extract(
  meta5$FastQNames,
  "[A-H][0-9]+_Plate[0-9]+_Seq[0-9]+"
)

meta5$ID <- str_replace(
  meta5$ShortID,
  "([A-H][0-9]+)_Plate([0-9]+)_Seq([0-9]+)",
  "Seq\\3_\\1_PLATE\\2"
)

meta <- rbind(meta4, meta5)

meta <- meta[meta$ID %in% Metadata_filtered$cDNAID,] 

# Relabeling Matrixes

## Matrix 4
colnames(matrix4) <- str_extract(
  colnames(matrix4),
  "[A-H][0-9]+_Plate[0-9]+_Seq[0-9]+"
)
colnames(matrix4) <- str_replace(
  colnames(matrix4),
  "([A-H][0-9]+)_Plate([0-9]+)_Seq([0-9]+)",
  "Seq\\3_\\1_PLATE\\2"
)

matrix4 <- matrix4[,colnames(matrix4) %in% meta$ID] #272

map <- setNames(Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell, Metadata_filtered$cDNAID)
cols_to_rename <- intersect(colnames(matrix4), names(map))
colnames(matrix4)[match(cols_to_rename, colnames(matrix4))] <- map[cols_to_rename]

## Matrix 5
colnames(matrix5) <- str_extract(
  colnames(matrix5),
  "[A-H][0-9]+_Plate[0-9]+_Seq[0-9]+"
)
colnames(matrix5) <- str_replace(
  colnames(matrix5),
  "([A-H][0-9]+)_Plate([0-9]+)_Seq([0-9]+)",
  "Seq\\3_\\1_PLATE\\2"
)

matrix5 <- matrix5[,colnames(matrix5) %in% meta$ID] 

map <- setNames(Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell, Metadata_filtered$cDNAID)
cols_to_rename <- intersect(colnames(matrix5), names(map))
colnames(matrix5)[match(cols_to_rename, colnames(matrix5))] <- map[cols_to_rename]

save(matrix4, matrix5, Metadata_filtered, meta, file="rda/counts_meta_adjusted.rda")
```

# **PART 5 - Creating Seurat Objects**

```{r seurat, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Convert Genes ID into Gene Symbols
load("gencode/gencodeM21.rda")

## Matrix 4
matrix4$genes <- rownames(matrix4)
matrix4 <- matrix4[grep("+_PAR_+",matrix4$genes,invert=T),]
aux <- strsplit(matrix4$genes, "\\." )
aux <- unlist(lapply(aux, "[[", 1 )) 
matrix4$genes <- aux
rownames(matrix4) <- aux 

matrix4[rownames(matrix4) %in% genes$Gene.ID, "genes"] <- genes$Gene.Name[genes$Gene.ID %in% rownames(matrix4)]
matrix4 <- matrix4[!duplicated(matrix4$genes),] 
matrix4 <- na.omit(matrix4) 
rownames(matrix4) <- matrix4$genes
matrix4$genes <- NULL

## Matrix 5
matrix5[rownames(matrix5) %in% genes$Gene.ID, "genes"] <- genes$Gene.Name[genes$Gene.ID %in% rownames(matrix5)]
matrix5 <- matrix5[!duplicated(matrix5$genes),] 
matrix5 <- na.omit(matrix5)
rownames(matrix5) <- matrix5$genes
matrix5$genes <- NULL

x <- setdiff(rownames(matrix4), rownames(matrix5))
matrix4 <- matrix4[!rownames(matrix4) %in% x,]

Metadata_filtered <- Metadata_filtered[order(Metadata_filtered$TreeID),]

Metadata_filtered$sister <- rep(paste0("Sister_", 1:203), each = 2)
Metadata_filtered$pair <- rep(1:203, each = 2)

matrix <- cbind(matrix4, matrix5)

# Filtering Genes
genes4 <- read.csv("paper_info/normalisedCounts_Seq4.csv", header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
genes5 <- read.csv("paper_info/normalisedCounts_Seq5.csv", header = T,stringsAsFactors = F)
common <- intersect(rownames(genes4), rownames(genes5))

genes4 <- genes4[common, ,drop = FALSE]
genes5 <- genes5[common, ,drop = FALSE]

keep <- unique(genes4$X, genes5$X)

matrix <- matrix[rownames(matrix) %in% keep,]

Metadata_filtered <- Metadata_filtered %>%
  arrange(pair, TrackNumber) 

matrix <- matrix[,Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell]

save(matrix4, matrix5, matrix,Metadata_filtered, file="rda/matrix_adjusted.rda")

# Creating Seurat Object
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = matrix,
  meta.data = Metadata_filtered
)

obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst")
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features=rownames(obj))
obj <- RunPCA(object = obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = obj))
ElbowPlot(obj) #5
obj <- FindNeighbors(object = obj, dims = 1:5)
obj <- FindClusters(object = obj, resolution=0.3)
obj <- RunUMAP(object = obj, dims= 1:5)

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = F)

save(obj,file="rda/seurat.rda")

# Extract Normalized Expression
norm <- as.matrix(obj@assays$RNA$scale.data)

save(norm, file="rda/norm_mat.rda")

rm(list=ls())

# Comparing Only Sisters (pairs)
load("rda/norm_mat.rda")
load("rda/matrix_adjusted.rda")
rm(matrix4,matrix5)

Metadata_filtered <- Metadata_filtered[,c(8,33,39,41,44,47,48)]

Metadata_filtered <- Metadata_filtered %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  mutate(
    symmetry_lys = ifelse(
      all(LysosomeInheritanceLabel == "high") |
        all(LysosomeInheritanceLabel == "low"),
      "Symmetric", "Asymmetric"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

colnames(Metadata_filtered)[1] <- "Lysosome"

norm <- norm[, Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell]

# Correlation - Histogram
meta <- Metadata_filtered[,c(3,7)]
rownames(meta) <- NULL

meta <- meta %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  mutate(cell_id = paste0("cell_", LETTERS[row_number()])) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_id, values_from = TreeID_Cell)

pair_cor <- sapply(1:nrow(meta), function(i) {
  cor(norm[, meta$cell_A[i]], norm[, meta$cell_B[i]], method="spearman")
})

meta <- cbind(meta, data.frame(corr = pair_cor))
meta$sister <- paste0("Sister_", 1:203)
meta$Lysosome <- "Asymetric"

p <- ggplot(meta, aes(x = corr)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 bins = 30, fill = "grey85", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_density(color = "black", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(meta$corr, na.rm = TRUE),
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Sister-Cell Correlations",
    x = "Spearman correlation",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggsave("plots/Histogram_Correlation.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)
```

# **PART 6 - Differential Matrix (Sister 1 minus Sister 2)**

```{r diff-norm, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Normalized
diff_norm <- sapply(1:nrow(meta), function(i) {
  norm[, meta$cell_A[i]] - norm[, meta$cell_B[i]]
})

colnames(diff_norm) <- paste0("Sister_", meta$pair)

save(diff_norm, file="rda/diffmat_norm.rda")

# Raw Counts
mat <- as.matrix(matrix)

diff_matrix <- sapply(1:nrow(meta), function(i) {
  mat[, meta$cell_A[i]] - mat[, meta$cell_B[i]]
})

colnames(diff_matrix) <- paste0("Sister_", meta$pair)

pair_cor_raw <- sapply(1:nrow(meta), function(i) {
  cor(mat[, meta$cell_A[i]], mat[, meta$cell_B[i]], method="spearman")
})

meta <- cbind(meta, data.frame(corr_counts = pair_cor_raw))

save(meta, Metadata_filtered, file="rda/metadata.rda")
save(diff_matrix, file="rda/diffmat_counts.rda")

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

# **PART 9 - Deciding Which Cell is Sister 1 and 2 Based on Lysosome Inheritance**

```{r deciding-cells, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/matrix_adjusted.rda")
rm(matrix4,matrix5, Metadata_filtered)

load("rda/metadata.rda")
rm(meta)

load("rda/targets.rda")
genes <- genes[genes$BP == "SRF_MRTF",]

mat <- matrix[genes$Genes,]
meta <- Metadata_filtered

# Sanity Check
stopifnot(
  is.data.frame(Metadata_filtered),
  all(c("TreeID_Cell", "Lysosome") %in% colnames(Metadata_filtered)),
  is.matrix(mat) || is.data.frame(mat),
  all(c("Genes", "BP") %in% colnames(genes))
)

Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell <- trimws(as.character(Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell))
colnames(mat) <- trimws(colnames(mat))

# Build Sister-pair Lysosome-based Rename Map
build_lysosome_mapping <- function(meta) {
  
  ids <- meta$TreeID_Cell
  lys <- meta$Lysosome
  
  stopifnot(grepl("_(R|Y)$", ids) |> all())
  
  pair_id <- sub("_(R|Y)$", "", ids)
  
  # Identity mapping by default
  mapping <- setNames(ids, ids)
  
  for (pid in unique(pair_id)) {
    idx <- which(pair_id == pid)
    if (length(idx) != 2) next
    
    l1 <- lys[idx[1]]
    l2 <- lys[idx[2]]
    if (!is.finite(l1) || !is.finite(l2)) next
    
    hi <- idx[ if (l1 >= l2) 1 else 2 ]
    lo <- idx[ if (l1 >= l2) 2 else 1 ]
    
    mapping[ids[hi]] <- sub("_(R|Y)$", "_R", ids[hi])
    mapping[ids[lo]] <- sub("_(R|Y)$", "_Y", ids[lo])
  }
  
  mapping
}

rename_map <- build_lysosome_mapping(Metadata_filtered)

# Renaming Metadata
Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell <-
  rename_map[ match(Metadata_filtered$TreeID_Cell, names(rename_map)) ]

# Split Genes by BP
genes_by_bp <- split(genes$Genes, genes$BP)

mats <- lapply(genes_by_bp, function(g) {
  mat[g, , drop = FALSE]
})

# Renaming Matrices
rename_matrix_cols <- function(m, map) {
  cn <- colnames(m)
  idx <- match(cn, names(map))
  
  cn[!is.na(idx)] <- unname(map[idx[!is.na(idx)]])
  colnames(m) <- cn
  m
}

mats_swapped <- lapply(mats, rename_matrix_cols, map = rename_map)

# Reordering Columns: R before Y per pair
order_R_before_Y <- function(m) {
  cn <- colnames(m)
  
  if (is.null(cn) || length(cn) <= 1)
    return(m)
  
  stopifnot(grepl("_(R|Y)$", cn) |> all())
  
  pid <- sub("_(R|Y)$", "", cn)
  suf <- ifelse(grepl("_R$", cn), 0, 1)
  
  ord <- order(pid, suf)
  m[, ord, drop = FALSE]
}

mats_swapped <- lapply(mats_swapped, order_R_before_Y)

# Validation
check_lysosome_order <- function(meta) {
  ids <- meta$TreeID_Cell
  lys <- meta$Lysosome
  pid <- sub("_(R|Y)$", "", ids)
  
  sapply(unique(pid), function(p) {
    idx <- which(pid == p)
    if (length(idx) != 2) return(NA)
    
    r <- idx[grepl("_R$", ids[idx])]
    y <- idx[grepl("_Y$", ids[idx])]
    
    lys[r] >= lys[y]
  }) |> table(useNA = "ifany")
}

check_lysosome_order(Metadata_filtered)

list2env(mats_swapped, envir = .GlobalEnv)

Metadata_filtered <- Metadata_filtered[
  with(Metadata_filtered,
       order(
         sub("_(R|Y)$", "", TreeID_Cell),      
         ifelse(grepl("_R$", TreeID_Cell), 0, 1)  
       )
  ),
]

rownames(meta) <- NULL

meta <- meta %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  mutate(cell_id = paste0("cell_", LETTERS[row_number()])) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_id, values_from = TreeID_Cell)

capitalize_first <- function(s) {
  first_letter <- toupper(substr(s, 1, 1))
  rest_of_string <- substring(s, 2)
  paste0(first_letter, rest_of_string)
}

meta_updated$LysosomeInheritanceLabel <- capitalize_first(meta_updated$LysosomeInheritanceLabel)

meta_updated <- meta_updated %>%
  mutate(
    channel = case_when(
      str_detect(TreeID_Cell, "_R$") ~ "R",
      str_detect(TreeID_Cell, "_Y$") ~ "Y",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  mutate(
    Lys_R = LysosomeInheritanceLabel[channel == "R"][1],
    Lys_Y = LysosomeInheritanceLabel[channel == "Y"][1],
    Lys   = paste0(Lys_R, "/", Lys_Y)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-channel, -Lys_R, -Lys_Y)

meta_updated <- meta_updated %>%
  mutate(
    channel = case_when(
      str_detect(TreeID_Cell, "_R$") ~ "R",
      str_detect(TreeID_Cell, "_Y$") ~ "Y",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  mutate(
    Cyc_R = CCPhase[channel == "R"][1],
    Cyc_Y = CCPhase[channel == "Y"][1],
    Cycle   = paste0(Cyc_R, "/", Cyc_Y)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-channel, -Cyc_R, -Cyc_Y)

meta_updated <- meta_updated %>%
  mutate(
    channel = case_when(
      str_detect(TreeID_Cell, "_R$") ~ "R",
      str_detect(TreeID_Cell, "_Y$") ~ "Y",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_R = Lysosome[channel == "R"][1],
    ratio_Y = Lysosome[channel == "Y"][1],
    log2Ratio   = log2(ratio_R/ratio_Y)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-channel, -ratio_R, -ratio_Y)

meta_updated <- meta_updated %>%
  mutate(
    Sym = case_when(
      log2Ratio < -0.6              ~ "Asymmetric (negative_corr)",
      log2Ratio >= -0.6 & log2Ratio <= 0.6 ~ "Symmetric",
      log2Ratio > 0.6               ~ "Asymmetric (positive_corr)"
    )
  )

table(meta_updated$Sym)

meta$sister <- paste0("Sister_", meta$pair)

)

x <- as.data.frame(corra)

a <- x %>%

  )

a <- a %>%

perc <- a %>%

  mutate(sister_num = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", sister))) %>%

  dplyr::select(-sister_num) %>%
  ungroup()

perc <- perc %>%

    score = case_when(
      check == "Negative" ~ -Percentage,
      check == "Positive" ~  Percentage,

    )

  ungroup() %>%

    sister = fct_reorder(sister, order_score)

  dplyr::select(-score, -order_score) %>%
  arrange(sister)

perc$check <- factor(perc$check, levels=c("Positive","Negative","No diff"))
```

```{r visual, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
  })
```

## Symmetric Lyso Low vs. Symmetric Lyso High

```{r symlow_symhigh, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
deg_results <- apply(diff_norm, 1, function(gene_expr) {
  group1 <- gene_expr[meta$Thr == "Symmetric_Lyso_Low"]
  group2 <- gene_expr[meta$Thr == "Symmetric_Lyso_High"]
  
  test <- wilcox.test(group1, group2)
  
  c(
    p_value = test$p.value,
    logFC = mean(group2, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(group1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) 

deg_results <- as.data.frame(t(deg_results))
deg_results$gene <- rownames(deg_results)
deg_results <- na.omit(deg_results)

# Adjust p-values
deg_results$padj <- p.adjust(deg_results$p_value, method = "fdr")

# Order
plot_volcano <- function(results, title = "DEGs (Sym High - Sym Low)") {
  results <- deg_results %>% filter(!is.na(logFC), !is.na(padj))
  
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_p = -log10(p_value),
      color = case_when(
        p_value <= 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "Up in Symmetric Lyso High",
        p_value <= 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "Down in Symmetric Lyso High",
        TRUE ~ "ns"),
      color = factor(color, 
                     levels = c("Up in Symmetric Lyso High", "Down in Symmetric Lyso High", "ns")))
  
  # Top 10 up and down by logFC
  top_up <- results %>%
    filter(color == "Up in Symmetric Lyso High") %>%
    mutate(score = -log10(p_value) * logFC) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = score, n = 20)
  
  top_down <- results %>%
    filter(color == "Down in Symmetric Lyso High") %>%
    mutate(score = -log10(p_value) * abs(logFC)) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = score, n = 20)
  
  ggplot(results, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p, color = color)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red3") +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = top_up,
      aes(label = gene),
      color = "black",
      fill = "white",
      label.size = 0.2,
      size = 2.5,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf) +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = top_down,
      aes(label = gene),
      color = "black",
      fill = "white",
      label.size = 0.2,
      size = 2.5,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up in Symmetric Lyso High" = "red",
      "Down in Symmetric Lyso High" = "blue",
      "ns" = "gray60")) +
    labs(
      x = "log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10(pvalue)",
      title = title,
      color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() + 
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey90"))
}

volcano_plot <- plot_volcano(de_results)

ggsave("plots/DEGs_SymLow_SymHigh.png", volcano_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

write.csv(deg_results, "csv/DEGs_SymLow_SymHigh.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# **PART 12 - Reported & Speculative Genes**

```{r rep-spec, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
yap <- read.csv("csv/yap_taz.csv")
srfs <- read.csv("csv/srfs.csv")
load("rda/meta_final_Lys.rda")
load("rda/norm_mat.rda")

genes <- rbind(srfs, yap)
genes <- genes[!duplicated(genes$Gene),]

spec <- genes[genes$Status == "Speculative",]
spec <- spec[!spec$Pathway %in% c("Both","Indirect"),]
spec$HSPC.Relevance <- factor(spec$HSPC.Relevance, levels = c("Low","Moderate","High","Some"))

rep <- genes[genes$Status == "Reported",]
rep[rep$Pathway %in% "Both", "Pathway"] <- "SRF_MRTF/SRF_TCF"
rep[rep$Pathway %in% "Indirect", "Pathway"] <- "Indirect_SRFs"
rep$HSPC.Relevance <- factor(rep$HSPC.Relevance, levels = c("Low","Moderate","Moderate_High","High","Some"))

# Reported
idx <- match(rep$Gene, rownames(norm))
norm_sub <- norm[idx, , drop = FALSE]
norm_sub <- norm_sub[complete.cases(norm_sub), ]

diff_norm <- sapply(1:nrow(meta), function(i) {
  norm_sub[, meta$cell_A[i]] - norm_sub[, meta$cell_B[i]]
})

colnames(diff_norm) <- paste0("Sister_", meta$pair)
rownames(diff_norm) <- rownames(norm_sub)

df_long <- as.data.frame(diff_norm) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "sister", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(meta[, c("sister", "Thr")], by = "sister") %>%
  left_join(
    rep[, c("Gene", "Pathway", "HSPC.Relevance")],
    by = "Gene"
  )

colors <- c(
  "Symmetric_Lyso_Low" = "black",
  "Symmetric_Lyso_High" = "blue",
  "Asymmetric_Lyso_High" = "red3"
)

pathways <- unique(rep$Pathway)

for (pw in pathways) {
  
  df_pw <- df_long %>%
    filter(Pathway == pw)
  
  png(
  filename = paste0(
    "plots/",
    "Boxplot_Norm_Lys_Reported_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", pw),
    ".png"
  ),
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)
  p <- ggplot(df_pw, aes(x = Thr, y = value, fill = Thr)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = NULL) +
    facet_grid(
      HSPC.Relevance ~ Gene,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = pw,
      subtitle = "Known/Reported Targets",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Normalized expression (z-score)"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```
